subject: research-verification/strong-warning-gate
statement: Compact research --confirm-all-pass must be rejected when runtime already detects a strong contextual warning: missing current-task source/evidence provenance, a subject-bearing potentially material open question, or possible stale cognition. Granular dimension-by-dimension attestation remains available so the agent can explicitly retain a warning as pass/warn/fail.
